Ram Temple Donation Probe Restricts Officials, Investigation Continues

A Special Investigation Team has directed officials of the Ram Temple trust not to leave Ayodhya as part of an ongoing probe into alleged embezzlement of donation funds. The investigation is examining donation records, including valuable items, amid emerging discrepancies. The matter has reached the courts, with a public interest litigation filed seeking a hearing on the allegations.
